description:
FILED s431 (Opus 5) by the P1 flip re-census.

`tools/drop-census.pl`'s population is perl-tests/*.t (111) + perl's t/ default dirs (527) + lib/**.pm (21).  `tools/corpus-diff.pl`'s SILENT-DROP counter reads perl-tests/*.t only.  So NO instrument counts drops in:

  * cpan-tests/modules (94 *.pm files; 402 counting its *.t) -- measured s431 by hand: 9 files, 15 drops, all in the Test2 stack of Test-Simple-1.302199 (`try { require $file }` x4, `require ... unless $INC{...}` x4, `local($\, $,) = (undef, '') if $\ || $,;` x2, `print $_ @_ for @$self;` / `printf` x2, a `?:` with a paren-less `grep BLOCK LIST` x1, one `Can't call method "content" on an undefined` x1);
  * the 14-dist CPAN board's own lib/ (28 modules) -- measured s431: 3 files, 5 drops (Text::Balanced x2 = #457, Sub::Uplevel x1 `$m if delete $INC{$m}`, Mojo::DOM58::_Collection x2 `return List::Util::first { ... } @$self if ...`).

WHY IT MATTERS NOW: the announce->DIE flip's ruled bar is "every remaining drop is a deliberate error test, a registered absence, or an odd single explained", and the flip's one supposedly-free increment is MODULE MODE (docs/drop-census-s419-flip-gate.md section 5) -- which is exactly the population nothing measures.  Module-mode drops are also the last FULLY silent members of the #138 family (`pl2cl --module` announces nothing, ruled s403).

DO: add a module population to tools/drop-census.pl (cpan-tests/modules at least; the board dists behind a flag, since ~/.cpan/build is not part of the repo) and bless its rows in the census the same way.  A module transpile must run with `--module` for the emission to be the one the runtime caches.

BAR: the census tool prints the module population separately; the blessed census gains its rows with causes; docs/drop-census-s431-flip-gate.md section 5 is the measurement.

s431 addendum: EIGHT of the 20 module drops were minimised the same session and filed as #464 (a statement MODIFIER on `require SCALAR` / a `local` LIST assignment), #466 (`print $_ LIST` -- $_ in the filehandle slot) and, on the same Test2 line, #465 (`$\` and `$,` are DEFINED in PCL, undef in perl).  #457 is the Text::Balanced pair.  So the module population is not just uncounted, it is where four fixable bugs were sitting unseen.


=== s433 (Fable) RULING (s431 Ask 3): PART OF THE FLIP'S BAR -- lands BEFORE the flip, in session Q1 with #467 (plan-post-s433).  The flip (ruled as a RUN-TIME die at the drop site, every mode) newly reaches the module populations, and a price nobody can count is not a price.  Also what makes #457/#464/#466/#465's progress countable.


=== s434 (Opus 5, 2026-08-22) DONE.  tools/drop-census.pl now has FIVE populations: perl-tests, perl t/, lib/**.pm, cpan-tests/modules/**.pm and (behind --board) the 14-dist board's lib/.  Every .pm is transpiled with --module (the emission the runtime caches); the board dists are read from docs/cpan-board14-s343.tsv and the build root from $PCL_CPAN_BUILD / $HOME/.cpan/build.  Per-population summary printed.  The blessed census gained the s431 hand measurement number for number: +12 files / +20 drops -> 39 files / 102 drops, with the 27 pre-existing rows byte-identical; TOTAL line == row sum.  lib/ also moved to a recursive glob (lib/File/Spec/Functions.pm and lib/Math/BigInt/Calc.pm had never been in any census; both measure zero).
subject: The #138 drop census has a MODULE BLIND SPOT: it covers perl-tests + perl t/ + lib/ and NOT the two module populations -- 12 modules / 20 drops measured s431, every one of them silent
